description: Extension and refurbishment of Hotham Primary School. Including demolition of extension to the rear of the building, provision of new hall, kitchen/servery and plant room within single-storey extension (approx 6m high) along Hotham Road.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - This development shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
Condition : 2 - Notwithstanding any materials specified in the application, details and samples of materials proposed to be used on all external surfaces of the development shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority before any works are commenced. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved materials. 
In order to assess the suitability of the proposed materials, in the interests of the appearance of the locality, in accordance with Council policy TBE5.
Condition : 3 - Details of any external ventilation equipment, including ducting, shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority before installation.
In the interests of local amenity and visual appearance, and in accordance with Council policy TCS13(h).
Condition : 4 - Details of the means of protecting the trees (which are to be retained) from damage during building works shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority before the start of any demolition, building or other work. Such protection shall be installed and retained as approved throughout the period of works.
To safeguard the trees in the interest of the amenity of the area, in accordance with Council policy ON9. 
Condition : 5 - Replacement trees, of a size and species and in a location to be approved in writing by the local planning authority, shall be planted in the first planting season following the removal of the trees hereby permitted.   
To safeguard the appearance of the locality, in accordance with Council policies TBE5 and ON9.
Condition : 6 - The premises shall  not be open to customers other than between the hours of 0730 - 2100 Monday to Friday and 0800 - 1800 on Saturday and no opening on Sunday.
To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policy TCS13. 
Condition : 7 - The roof of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden, sitting out area or for any purpose of a similar nature without the prior written consent of the local planning authority.
To protect the privacy of neighbours and prevent overlooking, in accordance with Council policy H4(c).
Condition : 8 - The development hereby approved shall be built to a minimum standard of 'very good' under BREEAM standards. Prior to the occupation of the approved building post construction review, carried out by a licensed assessor, confirming appropriate compliance shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
To ensure that sustainability measures are included in the development.
Condition : 9 - Details of proposed boundary treatment shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. Such details as may be approved shall be carried out prior to occupation of the building(s).  
To ensure a satisfactory appearance and to accord with Council policy TBE5.
Condition : 10 - Notwithstanding the approved drawings, details of an inward opening door to the proposed disabled WC in the single-storey part of the propsoed extension shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before development commences.
To ensure disabled people can satisfactorily use the building and to ensure an appropriate appearance.
Condition : 11 - REASON FOR GRANTING PLANNING PERMISSION
The Council has had regard to the development plan (in particular policies TBE5, TBE10, TBE11, CS3, T1), to any representations received and to other material planning considerations.
The proposal is substantially in accordance with the development plan.
Condition : 12 - INFORMATIVE: The applicant is advised that the green travel plan should be updated to include means of staggering the arrival and departure times of the pupils in order to reduce pressure at peak drop off and pick up times.
Condition : 13 - INFORMATIVE: The applicant is advised that the cost of any necessary alterations on the public highway as a result of the changes to access arrangements to the school will have to be met by the Education Department.
